options.name: daemon_reload
options.description: Whether to run C(systemctl daemon-reload) after the unit file has changed. For I(scope=user) the reload is issued against the target user's service manager.

options.name: description
options.description: Convenience shortcut for the C(Description) key of the [Unit] section. Only applied when C(unit.Description) is not set explicitly.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the timer should be enabled or disabled using C(systemctl enable/disable). C(null) means the enable state is not changed. For I(scope=user) the target user's service manager is used (C(systemctl --user --machine=<user>@.host)), which must be running.

options.name: group
options.description: Group of the .timer file. When unset, defaults to C(root) for I(scope=system) and to the primary group of I(user) for I(scope=user).

options.name: install
options.description: Options for the [Install] section as a key/value mapping.

options.name: name
options.description: Base name of the timer unit (without ".timer"). The file is written to I(path)/<name>.timer.

options.name: owner
options.description: Owner of the .timer file. When unset, defaults to C(root) for I(scope=system) and to I(user) for I(scope=user).

options.name: path
options.description: Base directory for the .timer file. When unset, defaults to C(/lib/systemd/system) for I(scope=system) and to C(~<user>/.config/systemd/user) for I(scope=user). When set explicitly, it overrides the scope-based default.

options.name: schedule
options.description: Structured definition for a single OnCalendar specification. Ignored when C(timer.OnCalendar) is set.

options.name: schedules
options.description: List of multiple structured OnCalendar definitions. Each list item becomes its own C(OnCalendar=) entry.

options.name: scope
options.description: Defines whether a system-wide or a per-user timer unit is managed. C(system) writes the unit into the system manager directory (see I(path)). C(user) writes the unit into the C(.config/systemd/user) directory of the user given in I(user), owned by that user.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the timer unit file should be present.

options.name: timer
options.description: Options for the [Timer] section as a key/value mapping. If C(OnCalendar) is set here, it overrides schedule/schedules.

options.name: timer_validation
options.description: Whether timespan-like [Timer] options are validated via C(systemd-analyze timespan). When C(false), timespans are only checked for being non-empty.

options.name: unit
options.description: Options for the [Unit] section as a key/value mapping. Values can be scalars or lists; booleans are converted to C(true)/C(false).

options.name: user
options.description: Target user when I(scope=user). The .timer file is written to C(~<user>/.config/systemd/user/<name>.timer) and the file (including any directories created below the user's home) is owned by this user. Required when I(scope=user), ignored when I(scope=system).
